Game Overview

In Italian Pizza Bakery, the core idea is straightforward: master the art of pizza perfection as an Italian chef. Swiftly dodge odd toppings and maintain your culinary integrity to preserve precious aura points in this fast-paced kitchen challenge. Can you keep up with the orders and uphold tradition? Get ready for a slice of excitement!
